scope: scripts/qualify_plcsim_signals.py on a frozen Debug build of 0f4ef125 (artifacts/an1, git archive), 85/85 steps, on one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU 1511 instance on Softbus of an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 whose program copies IB20 to QB20 and IW22 + 1 to QW22. Symbolic output writes (1 November audit fix): sim_write of the output tag SigOutWord (%QW22), quoted and unquoted, and a sim_write_signals batch of SigMarker (%MW30), "SigDb".VInt and SigOutByte (%QB20) were refused with InvalidRequest naming the output symbol (details.symbol, area Output), and single sim_read calls before and after showed every value unchanged; a sim_test step writing SigOutByte was refused the same way and saved no report under simulation-tests; one sim_write of SigMarker, "SigDb".VInt and the input SigInByte (%IB20) then read back. The run also repeated the signals, areas, observation, foreign-instance and released-instance checks of local.plcsim_signals.20261030.
limitations: One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU 1511 instance on Softbus; output tags at %QB20 and %QW22 without a configured I/O module. Output elements or members of a structured output tag, and diagnostic_plcsim_write, which shares the check, are not exercised natively.
The program writes both output tags every scan, so the unchanged reads after a refusal show the refusal and the scan agree; a write that slipped through would be overwritten at the next scan.
Engineering scratch and simulation only; no physical PLC.

steps: resolve the fixture in the PLCSIM tag list
sim_write_signals every primitive type, read back by sim_read and sim_read_signals
sim_read_signals: an unknown symbol rejects the batch; without it the batch reads
refuse sim_write_signals: a uint8 out of range
sim_write_signals reports a failed item as PartialSimulationWrite
input bytes written by address read back symbolically and through the program's outputs
marker words by address against symbolic reads and writes
bits by address against symbolic reads
refuse sim_area_read: a range beyond the marker area
refuse sim_area_write: a write beyond the input area
refuse sim_write: the output tag SigOutWord quoted
refuse sim_write: the output tag SigOutWord unquoted
refuse sim_write_signals: a batch with the output tag SigOutByte
refuse sim_test: a step writing the output tag SigOutByte
the refused sim_test saved no report
sim_write of a marker, a DB member and an input reads back
sim_observe sees the program's STP take the CPU from RUN to STOP
sim_observe an external API client's Run:1500,Stop:2000,Run:1500
sim_observe an external API client's Stop:1500
return to RUN after the external STOP
register a foreign instance through a separate API client
observe and read the foreign instance
unregister the foreign instance through its holding client
